why: The stable door is mentioned repeatedly: locked, then found open, and the police theory has Simpson opening it.
The police theory in ¶46 has Simpson obtaining a duplicate key.

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — steal the horse
why: The police theory says the stranger (Simpson) intended to kidnap the horse.

text: Why did Straker go out at one in the morning? — to injure the horse
why: The story says Straker went out from anxiety to check the horses; nothing so far suggests he meant to harm Silver Blaze.

text: Where is Silver Blaze? — at a secret hiding-place
why: ¶46 raises the possibility that the thief led the horse to some secret hiding-place.
